Dear Anita,

Harbor Ridge Capital has a tax document for you: Schedule K-1 for 2026, Harbor Ridge Fund II. It can be delivered to you electronically only with your consent.

To read how electronic delivery works and give your consent, use the link below on any device.

Review and give your consent:
https://portal.example/portal.html?server=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.example#taxdoc-sample

You will be asked for the last four digits of the tax number you gave Harbor Ridge Capital. Once you consent, the document opens there; use Save to keep a copy, and print the saved file.

If you do not consent, the document will be sent to you on paper.
